title: Derive compute-stage order from declared resource hazards
body: BuildRenderGraph currently needs hand-authored RENDER_COMPLETE_SEMAPHORE to ORDERING_WAIT_SEMAPHORE links for SpatialReuseShade -> ExposureMeter -> ExposureReduce -> ExposureTonemap because shared resource hazards declare access but do not order independent submits. Derive the required stage order and memory dependency from facade resource declarations so adding a consumer and reduction pass does not require manual graph edges.

title: Serialize GoogleTest discovery during parallel builds
body: The queued command bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent upscalebugs --resource build --label upscalebugs:target-build -- cmake --build build --parallel 4 exited 2 when CMake GoogleTest discovery timed out launching test_ui_composition_host. The queued retry bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent upscalebugs --resource build --label upscalebugs:ui-host-recovery -- cmake --build build --parallel 1 --target test_ui_composition_host passed. Serialize post-link discovery or give it an appropriate time budget so normal parallel builds remain reliable.

title: Make FetchContent cache selection automatic for worktrees
body: The VIXEN configure used an explicit VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE worktree override to select the shared content cache, then the queued build completed successfully. Make the supported preset or queued build wrapper derive that cache path so each lane does not need a manual environment variable.
